results.controlIntent: a. Develop a current baseline configuration of the system, document it, and maintain it under configuration control; and b. Review and update that baseline configuration: 1. [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; 2. When [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances] require a review and update; and 3. When system components are installed or upgraded.

judgment.rationale: CM-2.r3 requires (a) a documented, configuration-controlled baseline and (b) periodic review and update of that baseline. The evidence retrieved shows only a single model package version (v1, approved 2025-12-01, ARN: arn:aws:sagemaker:us-east-1:123456789012:model-package/churn-predictor/1), with no subsequent versions, no change history, and no lineage data — indicating the baseline has never been reviewed or updated since initial deployment. The endpoint configuration (ml.m5.large, network isolation disabled, data capture disabled) reveals additional concerns: data capture is entirely off (capturePercentage=0, captureDestination=null), meaning there is no runtime monitoring to detect configuration drift, and network isolation is disabled, which would typically be a baseline security requirement. Together, these signals indicate that while a registry entry exists (a partial form of documentation), there is no evidence of: (1) a formally documented baseline configuration artifact, (2) a defined review frequency or triggering circumstances, (3) any review or update cycle having occurred, or (4) configuration control processes beyond the initial approval. The control is therefore not satisfied.
gaps: No documented baseline configuration artifact (e.g., IaC template, configuration document, or change log) was retrievable
No evidence of a defined review frequency or organization-defined triggering circumstances for baseline updates
No model lineage or version history beyond v1 — cannot confirm any review-and-update cycle has occurred
Data capture is disabled (capturePercentage=0), preventing runtime drift detection that would support baseline maintenance
Network isolation is disabled — no evidence this was evaluated as part of a baseline review
Human attestation needed to confirm whether out-of-band configuration management processes (e.g., change control board, CMDB records) exist
